headline: Record revenue on AI demand; margins expand, outlook issued
summary_short: MPWR reported record Q2 FY2026 revenue of $980.6M, up 21.9% q/q and 47.6% y/y, with GAAP diluted EPS of $5.22 (+85.8% y/y) as Enterprise Data/AI-server demand drove GAAP operating margin to 31.0%.
summary_long: Revenue rose 21.9% q/q and 47.6% y/y to $980.6M, a record, led by Enterprise Data (+44.8% q/q, +164.3% y/y) on higher AI/server power-solution sales; Communications also grew (+18.0% q/q) on optical module/switch demand. GAAP gross margin was roughly flat at 55.2%, while GAAP operating margin rose to 31.0% from 30.0% as opex grew slower than revenue. GAAP diluted EPS was $5.22 (+85.8% y/y); non-GAAP diluted EPS was $6.50. Cash, equivalents and short-term investments were $1,413.8M, up from $1,367.1M last quarter; the board added $500M to buyback authorization (total $1B). MPS guided Q3 2026 revenue of $1,140M-$1,160M and non-GAAP gross margin of 55.4%-56.0%.

drivers.explanation: Enterprise Data revenue rose 44.8% q/q and 164.3% y/y to $380.6M (38.8% of total) on higher sales of power management solutions for AI and server applications; Communications rose 18.0% q/q on optical module and switch demand.
GAAP operating margin rose 100bps q/q to 31.0% as opex grew 16.3% q/q, slower than revenue's 21.9% q/q growth; gross margin itself was roughly flat.

GAAP diluted EPS grew faster than revenue on operating leverage; non-GAAP diluted EPS of $6.50 excludes stock-based compensation, intangible amortization, and deferred-compensation-plan expense per management's reconciliation.

CEO Michael Hsing attributed results to the strength of MPS's diversified model and its transformation from a chip-only supplier to a full-service solutions provider; the company guided Q3 2026 revenue of $1,140M-$1,160M.
